home.intro: In-browser tool for AI stickers and transparent images: remove backgrounds, unify sizes, split sticker sheets, export in bulk.
home.privacy: Images are processed locally in your browser by default and are never uploaded to our servers.

single.title: Single Image Processing
single.desc: Upload an image, remove its background, resize and export a true transparent PNG.

batch.title: Batch Processing
batch.desc: Process multiple images at once with shared settings and a ZIP download.

split.title: Split a Sticker Sheet
split.desc: Split one multi-sticker image into standalone stickers and export them separately.

guide.title: Sticker Prompt Guide
guide.desc: Character, style and mood libraries with a copy-ready AI prompt builder.
